{"metadata":{"description":"Snapshot-first Playwright browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-tree interaction with stable refs, per-session browser contexts, 17 browser_* tools.","id":"gh:1333986490","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-browser-playwright","slug":"ChenyuHeee/dsh-browser-playwright","topics":["browser-automation","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","playwright"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Snapshot-first Playwright browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-tree interaction wi"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"th stable refs, per-session browser contexts, 17 browser_* tools."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-browser-playwright"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Playwright-powered browser capability for DeepSeek Harness: the agent drives a real browser through "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"**accessibility snapshots with stable element refs** — no CSS-selector guessing, no full-DOM dumps. "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"One browser session per harness session, tabs, screenshots as durable image attachments, structured "},{"id":"p3s4","text":"extraction, and gated JavaScript evaluation."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The bundle mounts three rows: the `ctx.browser` seam (`service`), the Playwright provider (`playwrig"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ht`), and the model-facing tool family (`tool`)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Browser binary"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The provider probes `chromium` → `chrome` → `msedge` → `edge` channels automatically; any installed "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"Chromium-family browser works with **zero download**. To use Playwright-managed Chromium instead:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Or pin a binary: `launch.executablePath` / `launch.channel` in the plugin config."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The default `toolPrefix` is `browser_`. Every action returns a fresh snapshot, so refs always come f"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"rom the latest result."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| `browser_navigate` | Open a URL (http/https only) and return the snapshot |
| `browser_snapshot` |"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" Snapshot the current page: URL, title, visible elements with `ref=` ids |
| `browser_click` | Click"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" the element with a ref from the latest snapshot |
| `browser_fill` | Replace an input's value; sele"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"cts match by option label |
| `browser_press` | Press a key (Enter, Tab, Escape, ArrowDown, …) on an"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" element |
| `browser_scroll` | Scroll the page or bring a ref into view |
| `browser_back` / `brows"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"er_forward` | History navigation |
| `browser_wait` | Wait a bounded duration for lazy content |
| `"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"browser_tabs` / `browser_open_tab` / `browser_switch_tab` / `browser_close_tab` | Tab management |
|"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" `browser_screenshot` | PNG capture stored as a durable image attachment the model can view |
| `bro"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"wser_extract` | Structured extraction: natural-language instruction → one parsed JSON value |
| `bro"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"wser_evaluate` | Run one JavaScript expression in the page (disabled by default) |
| `browser_close`"},{"id":"p14s11","text":" | Close the session's browser; the next call opens a fresh one |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Snapshot example"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The model then calls `browser_click` with `ref: e2`. Invisible content is excluded, node and text ca"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ps bound the token cost, and truncation is flagged in the result."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"All tunables are patchable through the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (later layers win per row)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`browser_extract` needs an auxiliary LLM route (`extract.provider` + `extract.model`); without one i"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"t fails with an actionable error. `browser_evaluate` stays off until `allowEvaluate: true` because i"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"t executes arbitrary page JavaScript."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"A swappable capability seam, one package:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- `service` — `ctx.browser`: the provider registry with configured-or-auto selection semantics (a co"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"nfigured id must exist; one usable provider auto-selects; several require an explicit choice).
- `pl"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"aywright` — the provider: one shared browser, one `BrowserContext` per calling session, LRU eviction"},{"id":"p24s4","text":", idle disposal, URL policy, and the injected snapshot engine.
- `tool` — the consumer: `defineTool`"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"-built tools whose canonical values are structured JSON and whose rendered text is the snapshot tree"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"built tools whose canonical values are structured JSON and whose rendered text is the snapshot tree."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Other providers (remote browsers, Browserbase, Steel, …) can register into `ctx.browser`; the tool s"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"chemas stay unchanged. Browser sessions survive across tool calls and keep cookies, storage, and log"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"in state within one harness session."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Test suites"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Suite | Command | What it covers |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Unit + engine integration | `pnpm test` (included) | Snapshot rendering, schema assembly, URL poli"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"cy, provider actions on real Chrome |
| Realistic scenarios | `pnpm test:scenarios` | Scripted-agent"},{"id":"p30s3","text":" journeys over a realistic local store fixture: guest checkout with coupon and validation, login/ses"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"sion persistence, multi-tab research, lazy content, infinite scroll, modal dialogs, popups, screensh"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"ots, policy, owner isolation, idle disposal, snapshot budgets — at both the `BrowserSession` level a"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"nd the model-facing `ctx.tools.execute` level (with fake attachments/LLM services) |
| Live smoke | "},{"id":"p30s7","text":"`pnpm test:live` | Opt-in checks against the real internet (example.com, Wikipedia REST). Skipped un"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"less `DSH_BROWSER_LIVE=1`; not part of CI |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The scenario suites are the plugin's most realistic tests: they drive the browser the way an agent d"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"oes — snapshot, find a `ref`, act, re-snapshot — and therefore double as executable documentation of"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" the model experience."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"From a DeepSeek Harness source checkout, load this plugin from TypeScript:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Model Experience"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### Tool schemas"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The 17 tool schemas join the system-prompt assembly through `ctx.tools.register()`; each carries a o"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ne-line task-oriented description. Snapshot results are bounded: at most `maxNodes` nodes, names cap"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"ped at `maxNameLength`, and the truncation flag is explicit."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Known Limitations and Deferred Work"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- **Selector-free, not vision-free** — interaction is a11y-tree based; purely visual widgets (canvas"},{"id":"p38s2","text":", WebGL, custom-drawn controls) may expose no refs. `browser_screenshot` + an image-capable model is"},{"id":"p38s3","text":" the fallback.
- **Cross-origin iframes** appear as leaf `(frame)` nodes without refs; same-origin f"},{"id":"p38s4","text":"rames are walked up to two levels deep.
- **Evaluate gate is config, not approval** — enabling `allo"},{"id":"p38s5","text":"wEvaluate` trusts the model with arbitrary page JavaScript; compose it with the harness approval/per"},{"id":"p38s6","text":"mission policy for stricter control.
- **Chromium family only** — Firefox/WebKit channels are not pr"},{"id":"p38s7","text":"obed; providers are swappable if another engine is needed.
- **Extract needs a dedicated model route"},{"id":"p38s8","text":"** — it does not reuse the main request's route; misconfiguration fails loudly at call time.
- **JS-"},{"id":"p38s9","text":"driven navigations are not statically checkable** — `allowedDomains` now covers `browser_navigate`, "},{"id":"p38s10","text":"`browser_open_tab`, and link clicks, but a button whose handler runs `location.href = …` can still l"},{"id":"p38s11","text":"eave the allowed hosts; deploy an external network guard for hard isolation."}],"truncated":true}
